name: Moped
description: A motorcycle or motor-driven cycle with two or three wheels, foot pedals for muscular propulsion, and a power source of at most two brake horsepower (1,500 W) that can't propel it past 30 mph on a level road; an electric motor qualifies, since only a combustion engine is held to 50 cc.

restrictions.rule: Two or three wheels and foot pedals that permit muscular propulsion
An independent power source of at most two brake horsepower (1,500 W) that can't propel it unassisted faster than 30 mph on a level road
A power drive system that works without clutching or shifting once engaged
Not an electric bicycle; an e-bike with a bigger motor, or modified past e-bike limits, can land here
Counts as a motorcycle or motor-driven cycle unless the traffic code says otherwise
The operator must face forward astride a permanent seat, or stand on the footpegs or pedals, and may carry a passenger only if it's designed for one
Handlebars or grips may be no more than 15 inches above the seat, it needs a handlebar or fairing mirror showing 200 feet behind, and any windshield must be shatter-resistant safety glazing
